visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler girl with short black hair and a straight fringe stands in a bright indoor room with light wood floors. She wears a white graphic T-shirt with the Traditional Chinese characters '暴走' in a stylized black font and light blue denim-style shorts. Her facial expression is curious as she looks around the room. Background features a cream-colored wall and a glimpse of a doorway. (2) The girl walks towards a wooden toddler walker filled with multi-colored geometric blocks. She grips the grey handle and begins to push it forward across the wood-patterned floor. A robot vacuum charging station is visible against the white wall in the background. She looks focused on the task of maneuvering the walker through the hallway. (3) The scene transitions to a brightly lit bathroom. The girl is seen from behind, stepping up onto a white two-tier toddler stool. She reaches for the bathroom countertop which holds a white sink, a soap dispenser, and various toiletries. A hand enters the frame briefly to guide her as she points towards a specific red toothbrush. (4) The girl is now being helped by an adult, whose hands and part of their dark-clothed torso are visible, to brush her teeth. She opens her mouth wide, revealing a pink toothbrush being moved by the adult. She has a wide, squinted smile while making 'ee' shapes with her mouth. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a modern bathroom. (5) The girl takes the toothbrush and begins brushing her own teeth independently, looking into the mirror. She has a concentrated look, moving the brush around her front teeth. The adult continues to provide verbal encouragement from just outside the tight frame. (6) A flat animation sequence appears on a solid pink background. It depicts a stylized cartoon version of the girl sitting down. White text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE' is positioned below the character.
